# Navimower Map Card 0.3.0

## Completed-session mowed areas

Navimower Map Card now uses the compact completed-session render archives provided by Navimower integration `0.4.0`.

- The active mowing session remains a live polyline.
- Completed blade-on routes are rendered as compact even-odd SVG mowed-area footprints that preserve untouched strips, Off-limit areas, temporary obstacle gaps, and other unmowed holes.
- Dock departure, return-to-dock, pauses, and inter-zone travel remain visible as separate stroked paths instead of being widened into mowed area.
- History dates come from the retained session index, and only the completed renders needed for the selected day are loaded.
- The main map request uses `include_sessions=0&include_daily_trails=0`, reducing the initial dashboard payload with Navimower integration `0.4.0`.

## Adjustable, zoom-independent map details

The visual editor and YAML now provide independent width controls for zone, Off-limit, VF-off, Channel, Gate area, and dock outlines. These use non-scaling SVG strokes, so the configured line widths remain constant on screen while zooming.

Zone name/progress markers also remain a constant on-screen size while zooming. The new `zone_marker_scale` option adjusts the complete marker, including text, padding, corner radius, collision footprint, and moved-marker leader geometry.

## Sections dashboard sizing

Newly created cards default to Home Assistant Sections **automatic height** and **full width** through `getGridOptions()`.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Home Assistant stores layout size separately for an existing dashboard card. Updating the JavaScript card does not overwrite those saved layout values. To receive the new automatic-height and full-width defaults, remove and add the card again, or manually reset/resize the existing card in dashboard edit mode.

## Visual editor and schedule saving

- Home Assistant native color controls are retained.
- The experimental duplicated manual HEX fields from beta5/beta6 are not included in the stable release.
- The stable module uses a new `navimower-map-card-v034.js` URL so browsers cannot reuse the beta7 module from cache.
- After all changed schedule days save successfully, the dialog keeps the **Saved** confirmation visible for 2.5 seconds and then closes.
- Validation and service errors keep the schedule dialog open, as does a new edit made during the confirmation delay.

## Compatibility

- Recommended backend: Navimower integration `0.4.0` or later.
- Existing YAML keys and visual settings remain compatible.
- Existing saved card sizes remain user-controlled as described above.
- No new runtime dependency is added.
- HACS installs the loader and all supporting modules from `dist/`.

## Included beta work

This stable release consolidates all tested changes from `0.3.0-beta1` through `0.3.0-beta7`: completed-session archives, lightweight loading, adjustable fixed-screen outlines, fixed-size zone markers, improved Sections defaults, schedule-save confirmation, and the cache-safe restoration of native Home Assistant color controls.
